diagnosis: The first mapping was exact over real arithmetic but changed float32 accumulation order at the folded input bias and one-margin output. Recurrent accumulation amplified the projection difference in P.

repair.public_interface: Retain 32 task channels plus the separate deterministic time scalar and return one binary margin.
repair.trainable_architecture: Do not restore reward, previous-action, explicit constant, value, or common-logit trainable parameters.
repair.converted_checkpoint_adapter: Only models created from a legacy checkpoint retain the legacy input base bias, constant-column weight, and two output heads as non-trainable compatibility buffers. The adapter reconstructs the active 37-wide numerical operand internally, with reward and previous-action entries fixed to zero, so PyTorch executes the frozen float32 projection and output subtraction in their original order.
repair.fresh_model_boundary: Fresh models used by later direct training do not contain or execute the compatibility buffers. They use the clean 32-channel projection, separate time drive, folded active bias, and one-margin head.
repair.local_trace: Keep the 105-scalar packed L implementation unchanged because attempt 1 remained within the registered local-state and readout tolerance.
repair.timestep_accounting: Keep repair1 unchanged: four support microsteps, two query microsteps, 168--216 generic active microsteps, and 56--80 effective P writes.

execution_order: Implement and validate the repair, commit it, create and commit a replacement source lock, then requalify. Preserve attempt 1 regardless of the outcome.
